//: Copy this file to appsettings.json (gitignored) and fill in your own keys.
//Assistant: Optional LLM for the flight advisor. Leave Provider as 'None' and the advisor
still works — it answers from built-in rules, offline and instantly.
Provider: None | Gemini | Groq | OpenRouter | GitHub | Custom
Gemini     - free tier, best quality: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
Groq       - free tier, very fast:    https://console.groq.com/keys
Custom     - set BaseUrl to any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint
BaseUrl: only needed for Custom; the named providers resolve their own.
Model:   optional; each provider has a sensible free-tier default.
Use YOUR OWN key. A key shipped inside the app is extractable, and everyone
running that build would share its rate limit.
